verdict.rationale: Salv's AI-Powered Insights is an in-product AI that adjudicates sanctions name matches and explains its reasoning, which covers the core of reviewing screening matches. It is explicitly informational only: it never closes an alert or makes the decision. The evidence is a single marketing sentence, and nothing shows the AI's rationale is persisted to the alert record or audit trail; the documented audit trail covers rule-based auto-closures, not AI reasoning. Missing for 10: evidence that the AI rationale is recorded on the alert/audit trail, any ability for the agent to act on or disposition matches, in-depth documentation of the feature, independent or hands-on corroboration.
